newsitem.title: UK: Activists urge Shell holders to take action.
newsitem.headline: Activists urge Shell holders to take action.

text.p: Dozens of angry protesters swarmed outside Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc's annual shareholder meeting on Wednesday and criticised the oil giant's track record on human rights and the environment.
About 40 activists gathered outside the meeting, beating drums and chanting "People not profits."
The protesters, including representatives of Friends of the Earth and Nigeria's Ogoniland region, urged shareholders to force the firm to beef up its environmental and human rights policies.
There were no signs of violence amid the tight security outside the meeting.
The Royal Dutch /Shell Group has come under increasing pressure from activists who accuse the company of harming the environment and supporting Nigeria's military.
The Anglo-Dutch company has dismissed such criticism, arguing that it has reduced emissions of greenhouse gases and is committed to human rights.
